Coram : D.K. JAIN*, ANIL R. DAVE
CENTRAL SALES TAX ACT, 1956: s .. 5(2) rlw Art. 286 of the Constitution and s.2(ii) of Customs Act - Goods sold at duty free shops at the International Airport - Held: State Government has no right to tax any such transaction which takes place at the duty free not within the customs frontiers of India - Karnataka value Added Tax, 2003 - Customs Act, 1962 - s.2(ii) - Constitution of India, 1950-Art. 286 -Arts.226 and 136 - Alternative remedy. The appellant, a dealer registered under the E Kamataka Value Added Tax Act, 2003 and the Central Sales Tax
